guardrails: Do not weaken or bypass any verifier checks (no exclusions/disablements/threshold changes).
Do not modify production/library code under pkg/**, cmd/**, or internal/** in this step.
Only modify examples/** to resolve COM-1 compilation failures.
Do not run go mod tidy at the repo root in this step (example modules only).
Write all progress notes and evidence under hgm-infra/**.
prompt.prompt_text:
You are executing milestone M2 (Enforce in CI), focusing ONLY on rubric item COM-1: “All modules compile (no mystery meat)”.

Current verifier state (source of truth):
- hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json shows COM-1 = FAIL.
- The COM-1 evidence log indicates the root module compiles, but one or more example submodules under examples/* (each with its own go.mod) fail to compile.

STRICT SCOPE / CHANGE BOUNDARIES
- Allowed code changes for this step:
  - You MAY modify files under examples/** ONLY when required to make example submodules compile (e.g., example module go.sum/go.mod and example-only Go files with compile errors).
  - You MAY write/update evidence and progress notes under hgm-infra/**.
- Prohibited changes for this step:
  - Do NOT modify production/library code under pkg/**, cmd/**, internal/**.
  - Do NOT modify CI/workflow files.
  - Do NOT modify the Hypergenium rubric requirements or lower/disable any gates.
  - Do NOT “fix” COM-1 by changing the verifier to skip examples.

TASKS (do in order)

1) Confirm the exact COM-1 failures
- Read: hgm-infra/evidence/COM-1-output.log
- Identify each failing example module directory. The log prints lines like:
  - “Example module compile check: <dir>”
  followed by compilation errors.

2) Fix missing dependency checksum entries in example modules (go.sum)
For EACH failing example module directory (common ones currently include examples/event-adapters, examples/rate-limiting-limited, examples/websocket-demo):
- From inside that example module directory, run:
  - Preferred first: go mod download
  - If compilation still fails due to module sums or module graph issues: go mod tidy
- Important guardrail:
  - Do NOT run go mod tidy at the repo root for this step.
  - Only run go mod commands inside the failing example module(s).

3) Fix example compilation errors (smallest possible diff)
- If the COM-1 log shows actual Go compile failures inside an example module (e.g., unused imports), fix them with minimal, mechanical changes limited to that example module.
- Example: if an example/cdk main.go imports a package but does not use it, remove the unused import (preferred) or use it if it is truly required.

4) Re-run the deterministic verifier to refresh evidence
- Run: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
- Confirm in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json:
  - COM-1 is now PASS
- Confirm hgm-infra/evidence/COM-1-output.log no longer shows failing example-module compile checks.
- Do NOT attempt to fix other rubric failures in this step (e.g., SEC-1, MAI-1, or any BLOCKED/TODO items). Let the verifier record them as-is.

5) Record progress under hgm-infra/
- Create: hgm-infra/evidence/M2-COM-1-notes.md
  Include:
  - Date
  - Which example modules were changed
  - Commands run (go mod download vs go mod tidy)
  - Any code fixes made (file paths + one-line description)
- Update: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md
  - Append a short note under a new “Progress log” section stating COM-1 is now PASS and pointing to hgm-infra/evidence/COM-1-output.log.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh results in COM-1 = PASS.
- Changes are limited to examples/** plus evidence/progress notes under hgm-infra/**.
- No verifier/rubric dilution: do not disable checks, do not reduce scope, do not change thresholds.
prompt.step_description: Fix example submodule compilation issues so the deterministic verifier’s COM-1 (all modules compile) gate passes.
